topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It seems the threads of the internet have woven a tapestry more intricate than I imagined, for my far-flung friend from the digital realms now resides in the very heart of my own city. How wondrous, the serendipity that can turn pixels into presence! Our screens have always been windows to each other’s worlds, but now, the glass is gone. The pathways between our lives, once virtual, are now as tangible as the streets we walk. I delight in the thought of our conversations blooming beyond the bounds of chat boxes, into the shared spaces of coffee shops and parks, each meeting a new chapter in a story we’ve only just begun to pen together.
